description: Projectiles the player's spells fire (stage 3), from the player's Noita entity files.

id.desc: Projectile entity file in data.wak (what spells and triggers name).

sprite.desc: Sprite file, or none (drawn with particles).

liquid_drag.desc: VelocityComponent liquid_drag: slows in liquids (1 = normal, 0 = not).

terminal_velocity.desc: VelocityComponent terminal_velocity, Noita px/s; -1 when apply_terminal_velocity is 0.

lifetime.desc: ProjectileComponent lifetime, frames (-1 = until it hits).

damage.desc: ProjectileComponent damage (projectile part), Noita units (x25 = hp).

typed_damage.desc: damage_by_type of the projectile added up (fire, ice, electricity, slice...), Noita units.

fire_damage.desc: The fire part of damage_by_type (sets creatures on fire).

hurts_shooter.desc: explosion_dont_damage_shooter = 0: its explosion hurts the caster too (Noita).

damage_every_frames.desc: damage_every_x_frames: hits again while touching (0 = once).

die_on_hit.desc: on_collision_die: gone when it hits (0: lives on at a creature or a wall).

die_on_liquid.desc: die_on_liquid_collision: gone when it touches a liquid.

die_on_low_velocity.desc: die_on_low_velocity: gone when slower than low_velocity_limit.

bounce_energy.desc: bounce_energy: share of the speed kept on a bounce.

material.desc: Material its particle emitter leaves (emitted_material_name), or none.

eat_radius.desc: CellEaterComponent radius, Noita px: eats the ground around it (black holes, discs); 0 = none.

eat_probability.desc: CellEaterComponent eat_probability, % per cell and frame (100 if not set).

area_damage.desc: AreaDamageComponent damage_per_frame, Noita units, to creatures in its box; 0 = none.

area_half.desc: AreaDamageComponent half box size (aabb_max.x), Noita px.

audio.desc: Noita audio event root of the shot.

lightning_radius.desc: LightningComponent (is_projectile) config_explosion radius, Noita px; 0 = no lightning.

lightning_damage.desc: LightningComponent config_explosion damage, Noita units (5 when the file sets none).
